projects.title: Portfolio Site ( CMS )
projects.description: portfolio is a powerful Headless CMS that seamlessly integrates with a React.js frontend using React Query for efficient server-state management, delivering a smooth and responsive user experience. The system combines dual database persistence between MongoDB and local JSON files, multi-layer caching with Redis and in-memory fallback, and enterprise-grade security featuring two-factor OTP-based password recovery. With hybrid media management supporting both Cloudinary and local storage, the platform enables complete CRUD operations for dynamically managing projects, education records, certificates, about sections, and CV content through a clean service-oriented architecture. The React Query integration ensures automatic data fetching, caching, and background updates, making it a scalable, production-ready solution that empowers administrators to effortlessly update portfolio content while delivering lightning-fast performance to end-users.

about.title: Hi, I am Manoj Sunar
about.content: I build web applications that don't just work they empower. As a MERN Stack Developer, I specialize in creating content manageable platforms with intuitive admin panels, secure authentication, and optimized performance. From financial apps to AI platforms, I've delivered production-ready solutions in every project I've touched. My latest creation? items.title: Bulk Audio Generator / Full Stack Developer
items.description:
AI-Powered Bulk Audio Generation Platform
Built a full-stack AI audio generation platform using FastAPI, Next.js, and PostgreSQL, integrated with ElevenLabs and Google AI Studio APIs. Users can securely provide their API keys, paste scripts separated by double line breaks, and generate 100+ voice/audio clips in bulk with automated processing and storage.
items.highlights:
Bulk AI Audio Generation — Generate 100+ voice clips from multiple scripts.
Multi-Provider AI Integration — Powered by ElevenLabs and Google AI Studio APIs.
Script-to-Voice Automation — Automatically splits scripts and generates individual audio clips.
Full-Stack Architecture — Built with FastAPI, Next.js, and PostgreSQL.
